description: This file defines a React component for managing data backup and restore functionalities within a web application, including download and import of backup files, encryption options, and user interactions.

methods.name: downloadDataArchive
methods.description: Creates and downloads a backup file, encrypted or decrypted based on user preferences.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a backup file, handling zip files and JSON content.

methods.name: performImport
methods.description: Performs data import from a backup file and displays result status.

methods.name: importFileSelected
methods.description: Handles file input change event, reads the selected file, and triggers import if valid.

methods.name: handleImportFile
methods.description: Handles click or keyboard event to trigger file selection dialog.
